flows.name: Idea to Blueprint
steps: Enter project idea in the hero input
Watch real-time agent progress on generation screen
Review complete blueprint on the dashboard

flows.name: Review Architecture
steps: Browse database schema and API endpoints
Optionally click 'Regenerate' for a fresh take

flows.name: Prepare Pitch Deck
steps: Check market analysis and business model
Export or screenshot slides for presentation

flows.name: Plan Development Sprints
steps: Share plan with co-founders or team

screens.name: Landing Page
screens.purpose: First impression — hero section with idea input, agent showcase cards, and feature highlights

screens.name: Generation Screen
screens.purpose: Real-time progress view showing all 5 AI agents executing in parallel with status indicators

screens.name: Dashboard — Architecture Tab
screens.purpose: Displays recommended tech stack, system topology diagram, database schema, and API endpoints

screens.name: Dashboard — Wireframes Tab
screens.purpose: Shows user personas, user flows, screen inventory, and component wireframe specs

screens.name: Dashboard — Pitch Deck Tab
screens.purpose: Investor-ready slides covering problem, solution, market, business model, GTM, and roadmap

screens.name: Dashboard — Documentation Tab
screens.purpose: Professional PRD with problem statement, product vision, user stories, and requirements

screens.name: Dashboard — Planning Tab
screens.purpose: Actionable sprint plan, milestones, development timeline, and team role recommendations

screens.name: Error / Empty State
screens.purpose: Graceful error handling when generation fails, with clear retry options

components: Hero section with gradient heading and textarea
Benefits section with mock blueprint preview
Animated orchestration hub with progress ring
5 Agent progress cards showing status badges
Tech stack category cards (Frontend, Backend, DB, Infra)
API endpoints table with method badges
Problem slide with pain points list
